item.title: Average tax refund up nearly 11% so far this filing season
item.description: The average tax refund was $2,290 through Feb. 6 — up 10.9% from $2,065 a year ago, according to the IRS.

item.title: ICE buys Orange County warehouse for new immigration detention center
item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officials purchased an empty warehouse in Chester, NY to build a new immigration detention center, which has faced opposition from state and local leaders due to environmental risks, logistical burdens, and lack of communication from federal authorities.

item.title: Why New York State taxes fund healthcare and benefits for undocumented immigrants
item.description: New York State provides several social safety net benefits to undocumented immigrants, including healthcare, food, and education, as required by the state constitution, while federal law prohibits the use of federal funds for these benefits.

item.title: One year after the strike: Can New York fix its prison system?
item.description: One year after thousands of correction officers walked off the job in New York’s second-ever wildcat strike, the debate over safety, staffing, and prison reform continues.
